_comment: A synthetic example of the DNSE /price/ohlc response, matching the schema
published in the official OpenAPI specification (spec/dnse-openapi-2026-09-15.yaml).
The values are the specification's own example, not a recorded provider

redistribute raw market data, so the repository keeps the schema and a
